channel.title: Ryan James V. Capadocia - Portfolio & Projects
channel.description: Recent projects and software updates by Ryan James V. Capadocia - IT Support Engineer & Software Developer

item.title: CapsStream — Self-Hosted Cinematic Personal Media Server
item.description: A modern, self-hosted cinematic personal media server for movies, TV shows, and anime. Automatically matches titles against TMDb for rich metadata and streams through a hardware-accelerated web player. Runs directly from an external hard drive with no cloud service required.

item.title: ID Generator — C# .NET Desktop Application
item.description: A Windows desktop application built with C# and Windows Forms for generating, customizing, and printing school or organization ID cards with photo and template support.

item.title: Internship Management System (OJT System)
item.description: A web-based platform built with PHP and MySQL for coordinating student internship placements, tracking hours, evaluating performance, and managing host company documents.

item.title: POS & Inventory Management System
item.description: A complete point-of-sale and retail inventory tracking system featuring transaction receipts, low-stock alerts, sales analytics, and automated reporting.

item.title: Blood Bank Management System
item.description: A healthcare database system to organize voluntary blood donor registries, monitor blood type reserves, and streamline donation appointment scheduling.

item.title: CSG Student Governance System
item.description: A digital governance and records management system for university student councils, officer directories, election records, and student body announcements.
